about: GTA 5's first trailer (Rockstar Games, 'Trailer', November 2, 2011, rockstargames.com/videos/s6c5c8co) and GTA 6's Trailer 1 (Rockstar Games, posted December 4, 2023 ET) side by side. Both open on a sunset, then a beach crowd, then ROCKSTAR GAMES PRESENTS over the skyline, then a vehicle across the water (same order in both); both also show the cops and a giant city sign (VINEWOOD / VICE), in a different order. Twelve years apart; Trailer 1 drew over 93 million YouTube views in 24 hours (YouTube Official Blog).

lines.text: Rockstar Games Presents, over the skyline.
Trailer one drew over 93 million views in a day.
lines.say: Trailer one drew over ninety-three million views in a day.

lines.text: Same formula, or coincidence? Which one wins?
